name: com.aminhp.kimodobridge
description: Real-time, interactive bridge between the Kimodo motion-generation model and Unity. Connect to a local bridge server, generate motion from text prompts, and retarget it onto Unity Humanoid characters (live preview, waypoints/constraints, bake to AnimationClip). Sequence multi-prompt shots in the Kimodo Timeline window, freezing the segments you want to keep. Independent wrapper — not affiliated with or endorsed by NVIDIA.
